pathAssistantSteps.info: Approvals are being collected. The request moves on automatically once every approval is Approved. Use Resend Approvals after a rejection.
All approvals are in. An admin runs Send to Sandbox to copy the request and build the products in the sandbox.
Products are being built and tested in the sandbox. Use Load Sandbox Build to bring the product links into the Part Codes, then Deploy to Production when ready.
The products exist in production. Each Part Code links to its Product.
